ns2:section.sectionText: This class is for declared Economics students beyond their first year with a priority for Seniors. This class will open any remaining seats to Juniors before the Fall semester begins. This class is a first-eight week class. The course will provide students with information on careers and graduate school following degree completion. This course is always restricted to declared Economics students (we do not offer overrides until you are declared). If you are a dual-degree, please email the Economics Department for approval: econug@illinois.edu
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Senior class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
